scenes.action: Alex studies diligently for an upcoming exam, while Ryan sneaks a peek at his phone for answers.

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.line: I'm telling you, Ryan, if we just focus on understanding the material, we'll do fine on this exam.

dialogue.line: You're so naive, Alex. Everyone cheats a little. It's just how the game is played.

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.line: I'd rather earn my grades honestly than risk getting caught and expelled.

dialogue.speaker: Ryan
dialogue.line: Suit yourself, but I'm going to do whatever it takes to get ahead.

dialogue.speaker: Ryan
dialogue.line: Ha! I told you, Alex, my methods work.

dialogue.line: Congratulations, Ryan. But I'm not giving up. I'll keep working hard and eventually, my efforts will pay off.

scenes.location: A job interview at a prestigious company
scenes.action: The interviewer asks Ryan about his academic achievements, but discovers discrepancies in his records.

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.line: So, Ryan, I see you graduated at the top of your class. Can you tell me more about your academic achievements?

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.line: I see. Well, our background check revealed some... inconsistencies in your academic record. Care to explain?

dialogue.line: Alex, I must say, your academic record is impressive. You've consistently demonstrated hard work and dedication.

dialogue.line: Thank you, sir. I've always believed that honesty and integrity are just as important as grades and achievements.

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.line: I couldn't agree more, Alex. We're looking for individuals with strong character and a strong work ethic. I think you'd be a great fit for our company.
